scope: Floopa's island, first Great Conch arrival, six material-consuming repairs, gryphon cave, mandatory shield and Little Pearl boss, fixed and incidental rewards.

prerequisites.notes: No quest prerequisite declared by helper. The Woodcutting/Crafting boostable=true helper metadata disagrees with the current Wiki's start-gate unboostable flags; all six are conservatively modeled unboostable.

free_sources.bronze_axe: near calquat patch west of village

remaining_review_gaps: Exact map positions of repair stalls, Hammer and axe spawn, player-owned ship arrival tiles and coastlines are estimated; Quest Helper supplies only major waypoints.
Whether Raley takes the list of repairs after completion and whether the shield is retained after the quest need in-game confirmation.
The model's shield_equipped flag represents the required cape equipment slot, which is not an inventory-level enforcement of actual gear state.
Gryphon and Shellbane combat XP, player food/prayer use and death/lost-ship recovery depend on fight and are not charged as fixed outputs.
Direct Port Sarim–Conch sailing after the introductory visit is modeled as an available sea connection; precise charting and vessel availability require live verification.
The Wiki guide is used as an observed current reference, not a pinned revision; pin source revision during independent review.
Optional postquest Gryphon repeatability, fairy-ring route and Little Pearl permanent access require transport expansion beyond this quest's mandatory route.
